description: This file declares functions and variables related to quoting and dequoting strings for shell safety and other language string literals. It provides utilities for quoting paths, arguments, and formatting strings with proper escaping, as well as dequoting functions.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for shell safety, writing the result into a strbuf.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv
methods.description: Quotes an array of arguments for shell safety.

methods.name: sq_quotef
methods.description: Formats and quotes a string with printf-like formatting for shell safety.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf_pretty
methods.description: Pretty version of sq_quote_buf, avoids quoting if not needed.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Pretty version of sq_quote_argv, avoids quoting if not needed.

methods.name: sq_append_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Appends pretty-quoted arguments to a strbuf.

methods.name: sq_dequote
methods.description: Dequotes a string produced by sq_quote.

methods.name: sq_dequote_step
methods.description: Dequotes a single item and updates the pointer to the next character.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_argv
methods.description: Dequotes a string into an argv array.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_strvec
methods.description: Dequotes a string into a strvec, duplicating strings.

methods.name: unquote_c_style
methods.description: Dequotes a C-style quoted string.

methods.name: quote_c_style
methods.description: Quotes a string in C style with optional flags.

methods.name: quote_two_c_style
methods.description: Quotes two strings in C style.

methods.name: write_name_quoted
methods.description: Writes a quoted name to a FILE stream.

methods.name: write_name_quoted_relative
methods.description: Writes a relative quoted name to a FILE stream.

methods.name: quote_path
methods.description: Quotes a path relative to a prefix.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string as a Perl string literal.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf_with_len
methods.description: Quotes a string as a Perl string literal with specified length.

methods.name: python_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string as a Python string literal.

methods.name: tcl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string as a Tcl string literal.

methods.name: basic_regex_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for use in a regular expression.
